name: Binance
tagline: Global cryptocurrency exchange APIs for market data, trading, and account management.
description: Binance Spot REST and WebSocket APIs for market data, order placement, account balances, and related spot trading. Developers use API keys with HMAC-SHA256, RSA, or Ed25519 signatures for private endpoints; many public market-data endpoints require no auth. Futures and other products use separate hosts and docs (e.g. fapi.binance.com). Rate limits and endpoint weights are published in the official Spot API documentation.

auth.details: API key via X-MBX-APIKEY header; signed endpoints require a signature of the query string using the selected key type (HMAC-SHA256, RSA, or Ed25519). Self-serve key creation in account settings; public market data often needs no key.

pricing.free_tier_limits: API access is free; usage constrained by published request weight / IP rate limits, not a paid API plan

rate_limits: Spot REST: typically 6,000 request weight per minute per IP (and related order-count limits); see official rate-limit docs for current weights
use_cases: get latest price for a trading pair
fetch order book depth for a symbol
list recent trades for a market
place or cancel a spot order with API keys
stream live kline/candlestick updates over WebSocket
check account balances for an authenticated user
